comment: Blocked A52 diagnostic for makemon.c:makemon -> worm.c:place_worm_tail_randomly. With seed 31047913 the Healer creates a five-segment long worm whose tail cells (12..14,2) are out of sight while its head (16,2) is visible. C display.c:newsym() uses see_with_infrared(mon) && mon_visible(mon) for out-of-sight cells (display.c:1070-1074); JS display.js:newsym() calls canSeeMonster(), whose ordinary cansee(head) arm displays those tails. The C recording is retained as uncommitted diagnostic evidence, not as a passing recording.
